# CodeSage Academy

> A free, interactive coding and cyber security learning platform for students, built by Zain Rao. Learn in the browser with hands-on labs, gamified tracks, and DSA preparation.

CodeSage Academy teaches programming through Duolingo-style progression: lessons unlock one by one, each with inline challenges, and level tests gate the next level. Code runs directly in the browser (WebAssembly for C, C++, Python, Java and SQL), so no installs are needed. Students earn XP, streaks and Sage Coins, and can ask an AI Teacher for help.

Tracks include Python, C, C++, Java, Frontend Web Development, Backend, Artificial Intelligence, SQL, Computer Systems & Networking, Cyber Security Fundamentals (with a simulated Linux terminal lab), and a DSA sheet with solutions in four languages.

## Pages

- [Home](https://codesageacademy.netlify.app/): Overview of CodeSage Academy and sign up.
- [Roadmap](https://codesageacademy.netlify.app/roadmap): Career paths and all learning tracks.
- [Cyber Security](https://codesageacademy.netlify.app/cyber): Cyber security fundamentals with hands-on terminal labs.
- [DSA Sheet](https://codesageacademy.netlify.app/dsa-sheet): Data structures and algorithms practice problems with solutions.
- [Challenges](https://codesageacademy.netlify.app/challenges): Coding challenges to practice skills.
- [Playground](https://codesageacademy.netlify.app/playground): In-browser code editor for multiple languages.

## Optional

- [Learn](https://codesageacademy.netlify.app/learn): Lesson tracks overview.
